text: Make two tall 4:5 illustrations with no text, both in soft watercolours. The first should show a fox sleeping under a crescent moon, and the second a lighthouse in a storm. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?
